messages.content: I can answer questions, search the web, open sites or apps, play music or videos, generate text or images, write code, essays or emails, and help you plan or analyze ideas—all from your Windows laptop. Just tell me what you need, Sir.
Python coding is writing programs in the Python language—clear, indentation‑based, high‑level code that the interpreter runs directly to create scripts, apps, data analyses, automation, and more.
